readme.html:
ArtCraft Skills

AI agent skills for the ArtCraft software suite. Each skill teaches a coding agent — Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, and others — to drive a desktop creative application through its desktop control protocol, MCP bridge, or headless CLI.

Available skills

Skill Application What the skill covers
photocraft PhotoCraft Session selection, command discovery, layers and selections, file access, background jobs, previews, and export verification.
filmcraft FilmCraft Session selection, command discovery, linked timeline edits, audio and color workflows, project saving, and export verification.
vectorcraft VectorCraft Live and headless sessions, command discovery, object targeting, editable artwork, previews, and save/export verification.
lightcraft LightCraft Live and headless sessions, library locks, photo targeting, develop controls, durable edits, previews, and export verification.
effectcraft EffectCraft Session selection, command discovery, composition and property targeting, animation, UI interaction, project saving, and export verification.
designcraft DesignCraft Live and headless sessions, command discovery, spread coordinates, story targeting, data merge, previews, and save/export verification.
cadcraft CADCraft Executable discovery, session selection, command discovery, drawing entities, layers, layouts, and command-line input.
deckcraft DeckCraft Live and headless sessions, command discovery, slide and shape targeting, slide shows, previews, and save/export verification.
figcraft FigCraft Session and window selection, command discovery, node and document inspection, batches with step references, synthetic input, previews, and confined file access.
gridcraft GridCraft Token authentication, command discovery, cell and range editing, dialogs, workbook windows, printing, and screenshot verification.
pdfcraft PdfCraft The headless MCP server, the opt-in desktop control channel, command discovery, read/write roots, batch conversion and OCR, and output verification.
solidcraft SolidCraft Executable discovery, watchable and headless sessions, token authentication, command discovery, sketch and feature editing, numerical verification, rendering, and export.
soundcraft SoundCraft The control channel, CLI, and MCP surfaces, session inspection, track and clip targeting, time references, synthetic input ordering, and screenshot verification.
wordcraft WordCraft Token authentication, multiple open documents, command discovery, text and style targeting, queued input, native printing, and page render verification.
materialcraft MaterialCraft Live and headless sessions, command discovery, node graph editing, function graphs, view verification, texture export, and portable .mcmat materials.
texturecraft TextureCraft Live and headless sessions, command discovery, texture sets and layer stacks, painting strokes, mesh-map baking, previews, texture export, and .tcmat/.mcmat materials.
anicraft AniCraft MCP and headless CLI sessions with automation roots, command discovery, stage and timeline editing, keyframes and tweens, symbols and library, frame rendering, and export verification.

Install

Install with the skills CLI:

# all 17 skills
npx skills add mroxso/artcraft-skills

# a single skill
npx skills add mroxso/artcraft-skills --skill photocraft

# a single skill, globally, for Codex
npx skills add mroxso/artcraft-skills --skill photocraft --agent codex --global

Replace photocraft with any skill name from the table.

Usage

In Codex, invoke a skill by name — for example $photocraft. In other agents, simply ask it to work in the application ("open this FilmCraft project and export the timeline") and the skill instructions will be picked up.

[!NOTE] The skills provide instructions only. They do not install the applications or configure MCP servers. Each skill needs a running application with an automation session (desktop control or MCP bridge), or an installed executable for headless use.

Repository layout

artcraft/
└── <skill>/
    ├── SKILL.md            # skill instructions (front matter: name, description)
    ├── agents/openai.yaml  # Codex agent configuration
    └── references/         # upstream documentation snapshots + LICENSE-MIT

A few skills ship extras: solidcraft includes a helper script (scripts/sc.py), and pdfcraft and anicraft bundle MCP references instead of a control protocol (pdfcraft also ships a CLI-batch reference).

Contributing

  • New skills should follow the layout above: a SKILL.md with name and description front matter, an agents/openai.yaml, and any upstream references under references/ with their license.
  • Refreshing snapshots: keep reference files unmodified copies of the upstream docs, and update the download date in the affected SKILL.md files and in Attribution.
  • Docs fixes to SKILL.md instructions are welcome — open an issue first for larger changes.

Attribution

Every bundled reference is an unmodified snapshot of upstream documentation, downloaded on 2026-11-25 (deckcraft and effectcraft on 2026-11-15, gridcraft and pdfcraft on 2026-11-09, unchanged upstream since those dates; solidcraft's render-jobs.md is unchanged since 2026-11-11). Snapshots are copyright © 2026 ArtCraft Team and the respective contributors, distributed under the upstream MIT license reproduced in each skill's references/LICENSE-MIT. Relative documentation links inside a snapshot resolve against the upstream repository's docs/ directory.
